items.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
items.summary: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In a deluge of nearly identical press releases, the various AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off "the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts - […]
items.author: Terrence O’Brien
